uav_takeoff.required_response: the aircraft becomes airborne after occupying its home pad
uav_takeoff.unknown_policy: unknown if aircraft height or home-pad geometry is absent
uav_takeoff.semantic_rationale: The airborne rising edge is the authoritative takeoff transition and the prior home-pad assertion supplies the lifecycle guard.

uav_landing.required_response: touchdown occurs inside the aircraft landing zone
uav_landing.unknown_policy: unknown if aircraft height or landing-zone geometry is absent
uav_landing.semantic_rationale: The touchdown rising edge is the authoritative landing realization; the same sample must be non-airborne and inside the landing zone.

restricted_region_intrusion.required_response: the aircraft is objectively detected crossing the governed restricted-airspace boundary margin
restricted_region_intrusion.unknown_policy: unknown if authoritative region geometry, activation, or boundary-margin evidence is absent
restricted_region_intrusion.semantic_rationale: The governed boundary-margin rising edge is the authoritative restricted-entry event.

altitude_excursion.required_response: UAV climbs or descends toward the assigned altitude band
altitude_excursion.unknown_policy: unknown if assigned band is missing
altitude_excursion.semantic_rationale: The assigned-altitude-band predicate is a one-to-one authoritative replacement for the legacy altitude excursion flag.

uav_separation_conflict.required_response: both affected UAVs execute deconfliction or one yields by hold/divert
uav_separation_conflict.unknown_policy: unknown if either UAV trajectory is missing
uav_separation_conflict.semantic_rationale: Pair separation below the governed margin is the authoritative UAV-pair conflict surface.

uav_pedestrian_near_miss.required_response: UAV pulls up or clears the pedestrian exposure zone
uav_pedestrian_near_miss.unknown_policy: unknown if pedestrian pose or UAV altitude is missing
uav_pedestrian_near_miss.semantic_rationale: The authoritative near-pedestrian transition supplies objective proximity; absent collision-contact fragments are not asserted.

uav_vehicle_conflict.required_response: the bound ground vehicle brakes or enters emergency stop after the UAV-vehicle risk transition
uav_vehicle_conflict.unknown_policy: unknown when UAV pose, vehicle pose, pair distance, pair TTC, closing speed, or contact classification source is missing
uav_vehicle_conflict.semantic_rationale: The executable projection detects the collision-risk envelope and vehicle response; it never fabricates the removed collision_contact fragment.

vehicle_pedestrian_conflict.required_response: vehicle brakes and pedestrian retreats or clears the conflict zone
vehicle_pedestrian_conflict.unknown_policy: unknown if pedestrian or vehicle trajectory is incomplete
vehicle_pedestrian_conflict.semantic_rationale: The vehicle-pedestrian conflict predicate is the direct authoritative equivalent.

vehicle_intersection_conflict.unknown_policy: unknown if either vehicle trajectory is missing
vehicle_intersection_conflict.non_executable_reason: The frozen 79-predicate vocabulary has no grounded vehicle-pair intersection-conflict predicate, and the L4-9 SUMO movements do not traverse a network-controlled RightOfWay connection.
vehicle_intersection_conflict.closure_statement: Add an approved vehicle-pair intersection-conflict predicate grounded in exact intersection geometry and both vehicle trajectories before enabling this event family.

corridor_congestion.required_response: hold, resequence, or divert reduces demand
corridor_congestion.unknown_policy: unknown if corridor capacity or membership cannot be enumerated
corridor_congestion.semantic_rationale: Corridor occupancy above capacity is a direct authoritative mapping.

structure_near_miss.required_response: UAV performs evasion away from structure
structure_near_miss.unknown_policy: unknown if structure geometry is absent
structure_near_miss.semantic_rationale: The L2 family records the governed structure-risk transition and does not add an unsupported collision-contact predicate.

forced_landing.required_response: safe landing zone is established, cleared, and used for touchdown
forced_landing.unknown_policy: unknown if descent driver or landing-zone validity is absent
forced_landing.non_executable_reason: No authoritative scene or land-use source materializes a PopulatedArea individual or an aircraft-to-area proximity relation.
forced_landing.closure_statement: Materialize a real PopulatedArea individual and exact membership/proximity relation before enabling this event family.

c2_degradation_loss.unknown_policy: unknown if link metrics are absent and no governed simulation model is available
c2_degradation_loss.semantic_rationale: Degradation and loss retain distinct authoritative event types; handover/safe-hold/RTH form the response surface.

gnss_signal_degradation.required_response: relocalization, safe hold, or route correction starts after a real GNSS service degradation
gnss_signal_degradation.unknown_policy: unknown if true and reported pose cannot both be recovered
gnss_signal_degradation.semantic_rationale: GNSS quality degradation retains the explicit service-model participant supplied by the authoritative predicate tuple.

gnss_spoofing_effect.required_response: a typed spoofing signal and exact navigation-effect relation are available before claiming the spoofing event
gnss_spoofing_effect.unknown_policy: unknown if true and reported pose cannot both be recovered
gnss_spoofing_effect.semantic_rationale: A typed SpoofingSignal identifier on the governed GNSS observation establishes the spoofing effect directly; navigation-error and route-deviation transitions expose its measured consequences.

charger_unavailable.required_response: route planner selects an alternate charger or rejects the task safely
charger_unavailable.unknown_policy: unknown if facility availability or reservation state is absent
charger_unavailable.semantic_rationale: Facility unavailability maps one-to-one; legacy alternate-accepted state is not fabricated.

pad_contention.required_response: arbitration grants priority and diverts non-priority UAVs
pad_contention.unknown_policy: unknown if requesters or pad capacity cannot be enumerated
pad_contention.semantic_rationale: Pad contention is a direct authoritative predicate; allocation fragments are represented only when UTM deconfliction is observed.

signal_malfunction.required_response: vehicle queues form and police/manual control becomes active
signal_malfunction.unknown_policy: unknown if controller health or signal state is absent
signal_malfunction.semantic_rationale: The malfunction-state rising transition names the affected traffic signal exactly; queue and stopping truth remain downstream observations.

road_closure.required_response: affected vehicles take detour and leave the closed segment
road_closure.unknown_policy: unknown if segment geometry or barrier state is absent
road_closure.semantic_rationale: Road-segment closure is the exact occurrence; the separate detour ontology type remains non-executable without a real barrier-to-route binding.

ambulance_priority.required_response: civilian vehicles yield and ambulance passes the conflict zone
ambulance_priority.unknown_policy: unknown if priority state or vehicle class is absent
ambulance_priority.non_executable_reason: Typed emergency vehicles and SUMO RightOfWay individuals exist, but no explicit EmergencyResponse or AmbulancePriorityPassage lifecycle binds one vehicle to one response occurrence.
ambulance_priority.closure_statement: Materialize a typed response lifecycle with exact emergency-vehicle, incident, passage, and RightOfWay bindings before enabling this event family.

av_safe_stop.required_response: AV reaches and holds a safe stopped position with warning active
av_safe_stop.unknown_policy: unknown if sensor fault or MRM state is absent
av_safe_stop.non_executable_reason: The frozen 79-predicate vocabulary has no AV sensor-fault, minimum-risk-manoeuvre, or safe-stop predicate.
av_safe_stop.closure_statement: Add an approved ground-vehicle health and MRM ontology module with engine-derived L0 sensor and stop-area state before execution.

pedestrian_medical.required_response: detection, dispatch, arrival, handoff, and resolution are evidenced
pedestrian_medical.unknown_policy: unknown if posture or response state is absent
pedestrian_medical.non_executable_reason: The event ontology contains the intent, but the frozen 79-predicate vocabulary contains no injury/detection/dispatch/arrival/handoff predicates.
pedestrian_medical.closure_statement: Approve medical-state predicates and deterministic responder L0 contracts before enabling this event family.

crowd_evacuation.required_response: crowd members move continuously from hazard zone to safe zone
crowd_evacuation.unknown_policy: unknown if crowd membership or zones are incomplete
crowd_evacuation.semantic_rationale: Evacuation activation maps directly; all-members-safe is represented by the falling transition rather than a fabricated predicate, and an explicitly observed aircraft safe-hold transition may evidence the response phase.

temporary_airspace_lockdown.required_response: the controlled region isolates the hazardous area while affected UAVs reroute or hold outside it
temporary_airspace_lockdown.unknown_policy: unknown if hazardous-release measurements, lockdown state, or controlled-region geometry are absent
temporary_airspace_lockdown.non_executable_reason: The predicate names the NoFlyZone region but no authoritative producer names the TemporaryRestriction participant required by the event ontology.
temporary_airspace_lockdown.closure_statement: Add a real TemporaryRestriction individual and exact restriction-to-region relation before enabling this event family.

rain_fog_environment.required_response: only an environment event is emitted directly; UAV or traffic consequences require independent rules
rain_fog_environment.unknown_policy: unknown if weather parameters are absent
rain_fog_environment.semantic_rationale: Rain, fog, and governed low illumination remain separate authoritative region observations; no reified weather-condition participant is fabricated.

crosswind_payload_swing.required_response: attitude recovery reduces swing or mission terminates safely
crosswind_payload_swing.unknown_policy: unknown if wind vector or payload state is absent
crosswind_payload_swing.non_executable_reason: High wind is authoritative, but payload swing and attitude-instability predicates are absent from the frozen vocabulary, so the compound event cannot be proven.
crosswind_payload_swing.closure_statement: Add approved payload dynamics predicates and a physical tether/swing L0 model before execution.

high_temp_battery_derating.required_response: planner replans, aborts, returns home, or lands safely
high_temp_battery_derating.unknown_policy: unknown if battery or temperature is absent
high_temp_battery_derating.semantic_rationale: Extreme temperature is the onset; battery-low and mission-abort are the only frozen downstream facts, so power-derating fragments are not asserted.

jamming_gcs_intrusion.required_response: channel protection, safe hold, or control-station recovery starts from exact station evidence
jamming_gcs_intrusion.unknown_policy: unknown if security telemetry or governed simulation state is absent
jamming_gcs_intrusion.semantic_rationale: Jamming impact and ground-control compromise retain real aircraft/station participants supplied by their exact authoritative tuples.

unauthorized_command.required_response: typed command provenance is available and rejected before claiming an unauthorized-command event
unauthorized_command.unknown_policy: unknown if security telemetry or governed simulation state is absent
unauthorized_command.non_executable_reason: No explicit runtime UnauthorizedCommand individual with sender, receiver, and source provenance is available.
unauthorized_command.closure_statement: Materialize typed command individuals and exact sender/receiver provenance before enabling this event family.

control_command_integrity_violation.required_response: a typed command stream and exact integrity failure are available before claiming the event
control_command_integrity_violation.unknown_policy: unknown if security telemetry or governed simulation state is absent
control_command_integrity_violation.non_executable_reason: No explicit runtime CommandStream individual and integrity evidence source is available.
control_command_integrity_violation.closure_statement: Materialize a typed command-stream individual and exact integrity evidence before enabling this event family.

security_control_unavailability.required_response: a typed security control and exact unavailability relation are available before claiming the event
security_control_unavailability.unknown_policy: unknown if security telemetry or governed simulation state is absent
security_control_unavailability.non_executable_reason: No explicit runtime CyberSecurityControl individual and service relation is available.
security_control_unavailability.closure_statement: Materialize a typed security-control individual and its exact service relation before enabling this event family.

charging_queue_over_capacity.required_response: the charging facility queue exceeds its capacity and the planner must wait or reroute
charging_queue_over_capacity.unknown_policy: unknown if facility requester counts or capacity are absent
charging_queue_over_capacity.semantic_rationale: Charging queue overload is physically derived from charging service plan requester counts exceeding charger capacity.
